boundStatus.detail: No complete-call upper bound U has been qualified for any profile. Live budgeted dispatch is mechanically impossible until a bound qualifies in the H07 registry; see h08-x-r14-1.md.

categories.description: Login, password, MFA, permissions, or workspace-access problems.
Questions about charges, invoices, refunds, payment methods, or subscription billing records.
Anything that fits none of the other categories.
Delivery status, tracking, delays, lost parcels, or wrong-item shipments.
Product malfunction, error messages, or how-to-use failures.

execution.correlation: the ai_budget::within scope mints one correlation id per case attempt; the runner verifies every accounting report carries that case correlation, and runs group by run id in the report

liveGate.priceTable: required: pinned per-token USD prices; absent (see priceTable)

execution.mode: strictly serial: one provider call at a time, no concurrent provider legs

feature: Server-side support-ticket triage: classify one ticket (subject + body) into exactly one finite category via a single SystemOne choice question.
instructions: Triage the customer support ticket into exactly one category. Read the subject and body, then select the single best-fitting category key.

ledgerPolicy.alternates: file backend (single machine) or SQLite file where PG is unavailable; both F04-qualified
ledgerPolicy.refused: memory and sqlite-memory backends: process-local, non-durable; the harness refuses them for metered runs

measures: verdict per case: correct | incorrect | abstain | invalid-output | rejected (with typed reason)
accuracy = correct / (correct + incorrect); abstains excluded from accuracy, counted separately
abstain count, invalid-output count, rejected count
tokens per case and summed: input_tokens + output_tokens, unweighted; breakdown fields never double-counted
latency per case in ms (wall clock around guarded dispatch) plus run max; reported only, no SLO
cost in tokens; USD only when a price table is pinned (none pinned: USD unknown)
budget/correlation checks: every settled actual <= U; ledger committed == sum of settled usage; every accounting report carries its case correlation

modelChange.candidate: any provider/model/version differing from pinned baseline
modelChange.comparison: same frozen case sets, serial execution, same request bytes except the model field; report per-case flip table plus accuracy/cost/latency deltas
modelChange.requalification: a model change invalidates bound qualification; the candidate profile must re-qualify its own U before budgeted sends
modelChange.reserved: held-out set carries no pass/fail threshold; it exists for model-change comparison

priceTableNote: No per-token USD price table is pinned: TypeSafe publishes no usable price in-repo and no operator price sheet was supplied. Token counts are reported; USD cost is unknown. Live runs stay blocked until prices pin (the H04 USD spend cap cannot be enforced against unknown USD cost).
registeredBy: H08 slice 1, before any H08 live evaluation result

thresholds.appliesTo: representative set only; held-out is reported with no pass/fail

amendments.change: Correlation rule corrected during slice-2 smoke test (still before any live result): v1 assumed one run-wide correlation, but the H07 within scope mints one correlation per attempt per the selected contract ("correlation may group attempts"). Case files, labels, thresholds, and measures otherwise unchanged.
